summary_1line: Arjuna asks to see Krishna’s divine form; Krishna grants celestial sight and reveals the cosmic form showing all gods, worlds, and the inevitable destruction of warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna reveals his universal form blazing like a thousand suns, with countless faces, arms, and weapons filling the sky while Arjuna bows in awe.
Arjuna sees multitudes of warriors and kings rushing helplessly into Krishna’s flaming mouths like moths flying into fire.
Within Krishna’s vast body Arjuna beholds the entire universe—gods, sages, serpents, sun and moon—contained in a single cosmic vision.
